name: Vending Route Operations
audience: independent vending machine and micro-market route operators
topic: route loading, service exceptions, and reconciliation for vending fleets

products.name: Route Load Reconciliation
products.product: A focused vending route load and inventory reconciliation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent vending machine and micro-market route operators
products.problem: Warehouse picks, truck loads, machine fills, returns, spoilage, and driver cash or cashless totals are tracked in separate records, hiding route variance.
products.valueProposition: Turns vending route load and inventory reconciliation into a visible operating queue so every route reconciles planned product, actual machine fills, returns, waste, and reported sales to explain remaining variance.
products.topic: vending route load and inventory reconciliation
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets vending route reconciliation, vending truck inventory, vending machine route sheet, and vending cash inventory audit searches.

products.name: Machine Service Exception
products.product: A focused vending machine service exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent vending machine and micro-market route operators
products.problem: Telemetry alerts, customer calls, refunds, technician visits, parts, and restored-sales verification are disconnected, so machines can look serviced while still unavailable.
products.valueProposition: Turns vending machine service exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every machine fault has impact, owner, repair evidence, refund follow-up, and verified return to service.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets vending machine service tracker, vending machine repair workflow, vending telemetry alert, and vending refund issue searches.
